Date: Fri, 5 Dec 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SCIM delta + service-account ownership for SOC 2 scope

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. As part of our SOC 2 scoping we need a narrow evidence bundle covering identity sync behavior and service-account ownership for the last 30 days. Can you please provide: 

- A SCIM delta export (preferably CSV) showing adds/updates/deletes for 2025-11-01 through 2025-11-30. Include timestamps and the actor where available.
- A mapping of service accounts to owning teams (owner email, justification).
- A short sample of SCIM sync logs for at least one tenant showing delta processing and any error lines.

We need this for an external auditor intake on 2025-12-10; if a compressed bundle is easier, that works. If anything requires redaction, please flag it and we'll advise.

Appreciate it —
Maya Singh
Security Manager, Helix Health
security@helixhealth.com

--
Attachment: None (initial request)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Singh <security@helixhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Dec 2025 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SCIM delta + service-account ownership for SOC 2 scope

Thanks Maya — we can get that. Priyom / Jonas: can you take point on producing the evidence bundle Maya asked for and confirm estimated delivery? Key asks below (from Maya):

1) SCIM delta export (2025-11-01 -> 2025-11-30) with actor/timestamp + change type.
2) Service-account owner mapping (owner email, owning team, business justification).
3) Sample SCIM sync logs from one tenant showing delta processing.

Constraints / notes:
- Redaction: remove any personal data outside of service-account emails (Maya will flag if needed).
- Delivery: ideally a single zip with a short README describing fields and any filters applied.

Priyom — please confirm whether we can include the raw sync log slice or whether it needs to be scrubbed. Jonas — can you validate owners against the ownership ledger and mark any gaps for follow-up?

I’ll coordinate packaging and sign-off from compliance. Target ship date: 2025-12-08 to give Helix one business day prior to their auditor intake. If you need more time, escalate to me.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park

Kim / Jonas / Maya — quick status update and plan: 

Summary of actions completed today:
- Generated SCIM delta CSV for 2025-11-01 -> 2025-11-30 (filtered to tenant helix-prod). File: scim_delta_2025-11-01_to_2025-11-30.csv (attached). Contains: user_id, op_type (add/update/delete), attribute_changes, actor_id, timestamp.
- Queried service-account registry and produced a draft owner map: service_account_owner_map.xlsx (attached). Columns: service_account, owner_email, owner_team, owner_justification, last_verified. Gaps flagged where owner not assigned.
- Extracted a 200-line sample of SCIM sync worker logs for helix-prod showing delta processing and a single transient 11/17 error line: scim_sync_log_sample.txt (attached). Log contains timestamps, request ids, and HTTP response codes.

Redaction checklist / notes:
- I removed internal-only UUIDs and truncated any long JWT strings in the logs. No PII beyond service-account emails is included.
- Where owner was missing, I left the cell blank and added a comment with the suspected owning team.

Next steps:
- I will assemble the zip and add a short README (access_readme.md) describing each file and the filters applied.
- Kimberly, please review the owner-map gaps and either approve or route to the relevant team owners for confirmation.

ETA for packaging: later today (2025-12-08 17:00 PST). If Helix needs earlier, I can accelerate.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
